primary_endpoint: Absolute change in HbA1c from baseline to Week 24.
efficacy_outcome: Mean HbA1c change was -1.11 with lanifibranor, -1.54 with lanifibranor plus empagliflozin, and +0.16 with placebo (p<0.001).
safety_signal: Serious adverse events occurred in 0/12 participants on lanifibranor, 1/13 on lanifibranor plus empagliflozin, and 0/14 on placebo; no deaths.
